subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: Should OpenClaw add native backup exclude-pattern controls now, and which defaults and protected paths should become the core CLI contract?
rationale: The missing capability is source-proven, but default filters and protected recovery paths decide the balance between backup size, sensitive-file avoidance, and restorable archives.

options.title: Review linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle defaults, protected paths, manifest/JSON compatibility, proof, and conflict resolution before landing or narrowing it.

options.title: Narrow to explicit custom excludes
options.body: Accept `--exclude` and `--exclude-file` first while deferring smart defaults until restore completeness and security expectations are clearer.

options.title: Decline native excludes for now
options.body: Keep core backups coarse, document current limits, and direct optional backup strategies to plugin or ClawHub paths after an explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle defaults, protected paths, manifest/JSON compatibility, proof, and conflict resolution before landing or narrowing it.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras has the strongest combined signal across original backup CLI review/co-author context and the current backup infra extraction.
